svg.title: Google Drive / Cloud File Sync — Dual-Plane Architecture
svg.desc: Dual-plane architecture of a scalable cloud file synchronization service showing the client sync engine with FastCDC chunking and conflict handling, the control plane with API servers, sharded metadata database, cache, notification service, and offline backup queue, and the data plane with content-addressed block servers, delta sync, S3 hot storage, Glacier cold storage, and cross-region replication.
svg.text: Google Drive / Cloud File Sync — Dual-Plane Architecture
Separated Control Plane & Data Plane (FastCDC, CAS, S3 & Glacier)
Embedded SQLite maps inode to file_id
Sliding window cuts on gear mask
Forks local edits to Conflicted Copy:
Zero silent data loss on concurrent edits
CRDT/OT live sync for Google Docs
Protects client SSD from multi-TB quota
HTTP/3 gRPC streams for rapid fetch
Publishes cursor bump to Kafka Pub/Sub
Absorbs read spikes on shared folders
Replication lag < 100 ms across read replicas
RocksDB LSM indexing for massive block manifests
Pub/Sub event bus wakes active devices
Buffers missed delta events for offline clients
Replays missed revisions in strict order
Peer receives push: downloads missing chunks
Each chunk named by SHA-256 digest
Delta Sync: transfers only modified chunks
Streaming direct upload via presigned S3 URLs
Parallel chunk transfer across 8+ worker threads
Automatic retry on dropped chunk connection
TCP BBR congestion control on chunk egress
1. Client finishes chunk streaming to S3
2. S3 ObjectCreated event fires to SQS/SNS
3. Callback worker verifies all blocks committed
5. Notification Service pushes rev bump to peers
Fetches Block table ordered by block_order
Client streams missing chunks in parallel
Verifies SHA-256 integrity on each block
Reassembles original file in atomic temp file
Atomic rename replaces local target path
Zero partial-read window for local applications
Resumes interrupted downloads via Range headers
Primary hot tier for active blocks
Cold Tier: S3 Glacier Deep Archive:
Cuts storage cost by > 80% on stale versions
Total capacity scale: 500 PB (Xu) to 2.5 EB (Prod)
